scenario: The ego vehicle travels straight through an urban T-junction at night while a following vehicle stays behind and another vehicle turns left from the right arm onto the main road.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward through the T-junction along the main road.

adversarials.behavior: The car follows directly behind the ego vehicle in the same lane through the T-junction.
The car emerges from the right arm of the T-junction and executes a left turn onto the main road.

spatial_relation: On an urban T-junction under dark conditions, the ego vehicle is on the main road approaching and proceeding through the junction, a following adversarial car is positioned directly behind the ego in the same lane, and a second adversarial car is located on the right arm preparing to and then executing a left turn onto the main road.
requirements_and_restrictions: Initial distances to the T-junction are defined for the ego and the following vehicle, and the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle has traveled through the junction and passed the merging area.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the forward vehicle on the main road; two adversarial cars are identified—one following behind and one on the right arm. 2. Chronology: Initially, ego approaches junction with follower behind and right-arm car waiting; midpoint, right-arm car begins left turn as ego enters junction; ending, ego proceeds straight while both adversarials complete their maneuvers. 3. Evidence: Headlight patterns show ego maintains straight trajectory, following car's lights stay aligned behind ego, and right-arm car's headlights arc from right to left across the junction.
